verdict.rationale: Sentry documents LLM cost and token tracking through the LLM Calls view and the Model Cost widget. It groups AI spans into sessions with `gen_ai.conversation.id` / `set_conversation_id()`, and it shows user `id`/`email`/`username` in the Conversations tab, so session and user context exist alongside cost data. missing for 10: explicit documentation that cost and usage can be broken down or aggregated per user or session, attribution to features via arbitrary custom metadata or tags, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance
The Model Cost widget shows estimated costs based on token usage and model pricing.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
Any of `id`, `email`, or `username` is sufficient — the Conversations tab displays whichever fields are present.
